summary: Official Afghan MUDL and Ministry of Justice sources establish national land/cadastre and property-registration functions, but no Shindand-local public parcel service, safe native ID, schema/CRS response, or polygon was verified.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: Separate English and Dari/Pashto discovery queries were executed and recorded in city-984-shindand.json. The current PRMIS landing page and JavaScript were inspected. Anonymous GET requests to its geolocation endpoints succeeded diagnostically, while Setup/GetProvinces returned HTTP 403 because access is restricted to Afghanistan. No parcel request was attempted against an unverified endpoint.
cityOrLocalCustodian: No city/local Shindand registry or cadastre custodian was established. MUDL and Ministry of Justice are national custodians/services in the evidence reviewed.
routesAttempted: All discovery URLs, route methods, and outcomes are recorded in city-984-shindand.json.
safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel/object ID when independently verified
schemaAndCrs: Unverified: no parcel-service response was returned.
